blocks.text: Halloween is creeping around the corner, and what better way to get into the spooky season than to indulge in films and shows that offer a few good scares? This year, viewers can look forward to several titles that are set to premiere in time for Halloween. Meanwhile, for those not in the mood for horror, there are also other genre options worth checking out. ‘VHS’ (Viva Horror Stories) “VHS,” which marks Darryl Yap’s first horror movie, is a three-part anthology featuring Sarah Lahbati, McCoy de Leon, Ella Cruz, Kit Thompson, Sachzna Laparan and Isay Alvarez.
